17.name: Root Cellar
17.why: The cool, earth-dark brown of a cellar's old timber, rarely touched by light.

17.name: Pinecone
17.why: A pinecone left out through a dry autumn, its brown gone dull and warm.

17.name: Gelati Beams
17.why: Old roof beams from Gelati, the Georgian thread I keep returning to in my own work.

18.name: Inkwell
18.why: A stoneware inkwell at rest: dark, cool, and faintly blue-gray in lamplight.

18.name: Wet Asphalt
18.why: A rain-soaked road at dusk, dark gray with the faintest cool cast.

18.name: Lamp Soot
18.why: The carbon old scribes scraped from their lamps to make their ink.
